title: NASA/Department of War special investigation of Apollo 17 lights image

tellings.quote: NASA released this image uh in the first trunch, there was a description about it uh next to the image and they say in the description that uh the department of war and NASA have opened an a special investigation for this particular image

plain: An image of lights from Apollo 17, the 1972 moon mission, is said to have come out in the first batch of NASA's 2026 release of UAP files, UAP being the official term for UFOs, with a caption saying the Department of War, as the Pentagon is now called, and NASA had opened a special investigation into it. Maaneli Derakhshani tells Michels this from reading the release: the description "next to the image" says "the department of war and NASA have opened a special investigation for this particular image." If true, it would mean both agencies officially think the image needs a closer look.
